result: In the editable top, replace circular storage and variable-indexed reads with three explicit `{data,last}` entries kept in oldest-to-newest order. On pop, shift remaining entries toward the output; on push, place the accepted tuple at the resulting tail, handling simultaneous push/pop and empty capture without bypass. Preserve the fixed interface, `// @latency 1`, capacity, handshakes, reset behavior, output stall stability, and all defined cycle behavior; the experiment succeeds only if it passes every gate, closes setup and hold timing, and uses fewer than 23 LUTs.
